constructors use the existing native factories; no pool is exported/recovered.

diagnostic probe. Source admission, topology, managers, contexts and their joined

Canonical owners remain durabledata, pipelinepersistence, eventrecord,

existing run-only version and aggregate progress. Full physical counts remain
physical, including diagnostic events where originally counted. Independent
scalar reads remain independent; composite receipt/handoff/attempt witnesses
remain single-snapshot cuts. Ordering, text casts, NULL/COALESCE behavior and

attempts retain all provider-turn rows ordered by attempt ordinal before the
